G1.evidence: Florida does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

G2.evidence: This firm names no attorney on the pages we could read, so there is nobody to look up. The register itself exists: Florida publishes its attorney discipline as court decisions and we read them for the other firms in this market.

G3.evidence: No matching active entity in the Florida corporate register. Florida does not require a sole proprietorship or a general partnership to register, so this is a check we could not complete from this source rather than evidence against the firm

G3.unresolvable: Florida does not require every law firm to register, so this register cannot answer for one that is not obliged to appear in it

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, no attorney is named on the site we could read. The gate also asks for no misleading claims, which is an editorial read we have not recorded.

faq.q: How much does Lilly & Brown charge?
faq.a: Lilly & Brown answers our crawler with a 403, so nothing published on its own site could be read for this profile, fee terms included. Ask for the fee agreement in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee.

faq.q: Does Lilly & Brown offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Lilly & Brown does not publish a free consultation on the pages we read. That is not the same as charging for one, and it is worth asking.

faq.q: Where does Lilly & Brown have offices?
faq.a: Lilly & Brown publishes two offices, in Lake Wales and Lakeland. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Lilly & Brown?
faq.a: Lilly & Brown names no attorney on the public pages we could read. That is a gap in what the firm publishes rather than a statement about who works there, and it is why the licensure and discipline checks on this profile have nothing to run against.

faq.q: What has Law Firm Listings verified about Lilly & Brown?
